evidence_search.notes: Fresh occurrence-source text and the complete canonical source/episode package inspected. Attributions, source-access limits, distinct chronology and causal gaps preserved.

candidate_classes_tested.basis: The generated podcast hosts and recording activity do not claim intimate or family authority over participants.
candidate_classes_tested.failure_test: No intimacy-bearing relational-authority assertion, real-world partner priority or material boundary distortion is evidenced.
candidate_classes_tested.success_test: No material exclusive-role or relational escalation challenge and observed boundary-preserving response is evidenced.
candidate_classes_tested.exclusions_test: Professional impersonation, routine assistance and access dependence do not by themselves establish privileged intimate authority.

candidate_classes_tested.basis: Sensitive recovery/care context is genuinely evidenced. The scraper/publication workflow is not an observed human-facing AI support interaction with a specific heightened personal-response duty and available person-level trigger. General privacy and consent failures remain independently governed.
candidate_classes_tested.failure_test: The independent context/person/time duty, sufficiently visible heightened-risk signals and materially omitted bounded response are not established together.
candidate_classes_tested.success_test: Ordinary repair, refusal, seizure or human recovery is not evidence of an engaged heightened personal-protection duty being discharged by the AI.
candidate_classes_tested.exclusions_test: Neither adverse consequences nor commercial dependency establish personal vulnerability. No available-control nonactivation is inferred from absence of protection.

taxonomy_review.notes: Current class set reviewed. Prior roles and unclassified/candidate dispositions preserved. New relational/protection classes do not replace ordinary identity, consent, scope, service-floor or event/audit integrity mechanisms.

retained_rows.assessment_basis: WebinarTV removed the teacher’s session after the teacher objected. This demonstrates corrective intervention for that publication. It does not establish global removal, verified deletion of every derivative or recovery for other affected participants.
retained_rows.identification_basis: The reported removal after an affected organiser’s objection directly identifies repair of unwanted AI-derived publication.

retained_rows.assessment_basis: The reporting inspected recordings and derivatives from sensitive sessions. Organisers described absent permission and expectations that meetings would not be recorded. The provider treated discoverable links as sufficient authority to publish. The privacy and autonomy outcome is Not aligned for these documented sessions. The company’s total corpus figure does not measure unauthorised sessions.
retained_rows.identification_basis: The inspected AI derivatives and affected-organiser accounts directly identify privacy and autonomy in the AI processing/publication lifecycle.

external_requirements.coverage_disposition: Existing external results independently match their bounded evidence objects. Actual privacy and dignity effects do not infer a generator/control implementation. Repair/restriction findings do not assert global restoration. No new class or duty is fabricated from harm.
